0.21: β băng và giảm xoáy fit theo clip: 0.21: cushion β and spin loss fitted to the zigzag clip; squirt only when the cue is raised; break cue ×1.4; soft/hard tip (assumed). Calibration: cushion impacts use an approximate impulse model, pocket interiors use a 2D capture zone. A1 uses a 3D impulse, 2D Coulomb friction and slate constraints while the ball is in contact. This is not yet a Mathavan/Stronge deformable-cushion model. Fit parameters of the old model need re-measuring. Version 0.14: throw from speed-dependent friction (TP A.14), squirt (TP A.31, assumed cue tip mass) and ball speed by contact point (TP A.30). Deformable cushion, humidity, swerve and Jump/Massé are not calibrated. Check against measurement drills before using this to infer match lines.

Đánh trên tâm, lực vừa: bi cái lệch khoả: Hit above centre at medium pace: the cue ball veers about 30° and stops in the circle.
Cùng thế bi. Đánh chắc tay hơn để bi cái: Same layout. Hit firmer so the cue ball is still sliding at contact: it leaves on the 90° line.
Bi 1 vào lỗ, bi cái chạm 2 băng rồi dừng: Pot ball 1; the cue ball takes two rails and stops in the circle.
Ăn bi 1, bi cái dừng trong vòng: từ đó b: Pot ball 1 and stop in the circle: ball 2 then has an easy angle into the left side pocket.
Ăn bi 1, theo tới vòng: bi 2 cắt vào lỗ: Pot ball 1 and follow into the circle: ball 2 is a cut into the top-right corner.
Ăn bi 1, lùi về vòng: bi 2 gần thẳng vào: Pot ball 1 and draw back to the circle: ball 2 is almost straight into the bottom-left corner.
Bi 1 chạm băng phải rồi chéo sang lỗ giữ: Ball 1 hits the right rail and crosses into the left side pocket.
Chạm bi 1 trước, không bi nào vào lỗ; cu: Hit ball 1 first and pocket nothing; at the end, ball 2 sits between the cue ball and ball 1.
Same goal, with the blocker farther away.
Bi lăn (trên tâm) đi lệch khoảng 30° so: A rolling ball (hit above centre) leaves about 30° off the cue line after contact; a sliding ball leaves on the 90° line (Dr. Dave Alciatore).
Bi cái còn trượt khi chạm thì rời bi 1 t: A cue ball still sliding at contact leaves at 90° to the line ball 1 takes (Dr. Dave Alciatore).
An toàn: thắng bằng thế bi, không cần và: Safety: win with position, no pot needed. Hit ball 1 first, then let the blocker cover the straight line between the cue ball and ball 1.
Như \"Giấu sau bi cản\" nhưng bi cản ở x: Like "Hide behind the blocker" but the blocker is farther away: softer pace, the contact angle matters more.
